_comment: NOT-MUSIC GATE. Málaga Live is a LIVE MUSIC site, but several venues we track publish their WHOLE programme — Auditorio Municipal de Benalmádena (operabenalmadena / tickets.oneboxtds.com) and Marenostrum Castle Park (marenostrumfuengirola.com) list theatre, dance, comedy, magic and children's shows next to the concerts, and the weekly LLM sweep takes the lot. Deleting such a row from the calendar does NOT hold: the next sweep re-adds it from the same venue page. So exclusions live here and are applied by build_site.py on EVERY build, as a gate running BEFORE the phantom / Fever-unbuyable / receipt gates. Matching is on the normalised act name (lowercase, accents stripped) and is a SUBSTRING test. IMPORTANT: set 'venue' whenever the phrase could belong to a real act somewhere else — a personal name ('David Navarro', 'José Tejada') or a common phrase ('La Granja') must be scoped to the venue, or a genuine gig elsewhere would be silently dropped. Omit 'venue' only for names distinctive enough to be safe anywhere. NOT blocked, deliberately: CABARET 2.0 at the same Benalmádena venue IS live music (Sofia 2026-07-29). This gate's drops appear in the build log's [gate] block. NOTE (2026-08-04): this file is now shipped by the canonical deploy-site.bat (added to its Website scp list), so a normal deploy applies any edit here — no separate genre-fix bat needed. This gate also carries OWNER CONTENT-POLICY removals (e.g. 'love of lesbian', DLR 2026-08-04), not only not-music rows; the log prefix 'not live music' is cosmetic for those.
